summary: This document records the Iceberg Spark integration updates, covering new features such as DSv2 validation, geometry bounds in Parquet writers, and runtime filtering improvements, along with bug fixes for ORC variant handling and vectorized reads. The discussion focuses on defining what "deterministic" means for UDFs used in stored expressions across different engines, highlighting issues with check constraints, stats-only fields, and derived columns. Iceberg 1.12.1 Yufei proposes a biweekly 30‑minute UDF sync to accelerate implementation and reviews, with an open Google Meet link for all participants. Some participants note that similar issues are addressed by other proposals and that the spec may not need to codify container details, but they highlight concerns about orphan cleanup and reachability.
